request: Build cube solver trainer MVP with harness engineering and split commits by stage.

tasks: Stage 1: scaffold runnable React/Vite/Tauri/PWA app and harness scripts
Stage 2-8: camera, scan, cube state, solver, step guide
Stage 9-15: learning data, algorithm library, progress tracking
Stage 16-20: build targets, docs, final verification
Split commits by stage without a single omnibus commit
Run internal verification after implementation commits
Push branch and open PR when possible

contracts.core: src/core exports platform-independent cube, color, solver, learning, progress APIs.
contracts.data: src/data/*.json conforms to Method and Algorithm models.
contracts.ui: src/features imports core/data only; src/core never imports UI.
contracts.platform: src-tauri and public PWA files wrap the same web UI.
